India's Supreme Court Upholds Protection for Fragile Elephant Reserve

The Indian Supreme Court has upheld a ban on commercial activity in the fragile Segur plateau, which is home to an elephant corridor. The decision aims to protect the region's biodiversity and ensure the well-being of local wildlife. The ruling comes as concerns over deforestation and habitat destruction continue to grow in India.
